text: I think you'll enjoy this recipe for Cinnamon Streusel Blueberry Muffins! Given your preference for recipes featuring bread flour and yeast, I'm not surprised to see all-purpose flour taking center stage here. The use of butter and sugar also aligns with your past choices. While this recipe does contain some sugar and saturated fat, the serving size is relatively small, and the nutrition facts show a balance of macronutrients. The fact that it's ready in about 30 minutes is also a plus, given your unknown time budget.
